items.title: Pay invoice for wedding invitations
items.quote: Den Rechnungsbetrag überweisen Sie bitte binnen 14 Tagen nach dem Rechnungsdatum.
items.computation: Invoice date (Rechnungsdatum) is 26.01.2026. Under §§ 187 Abs. 1, 188 Abs. 1 BGB, the day of the triggering event (26 Jan) is not counted; the 14-day period starts 27 Jan 2026 and its 14th day is 09.02.2026 (a Monday, so no weekend/holiday shift needed). However, the letter separately prints a fixed due date 'Zahlbar bis: 16.02.2026', which is 21 days after the invoice date and contradicts the stated 14-day period. Per the rule to resolve contradictions by taking the earliest plausible date, the due date is set to 09.02.2026, with confidence lowered and a warning added about the discrepancy.

warnings: The letter contradicts itself on the payment deadline: it states 'binnen 14 Tagen nach dem Rechnungsdatum' (which would be 09.02.2026 from the 26.01.2026 invoice date) but also prints 'Zahlbar bis: 16.02.2026' (21 days later); the earlier date (09.02.2026) was used as a precaution, but the recipient should check which deadline the printer actually intends.
The customer address on the invoice (Am Mühlbach 2, 35039 Musterbergen) differs from the recipient's stated region (NRW); double-check that this invoice is addressed to the correct person/address.
